findings_resolved: Exact closed primitive scope and activation bind source, plan, profile, owned client/application/environment, OS owner, root inode/device, command identities, deadlines and separate approval prerequisites. Absent approval holds before effects.

One fixed root claim precedes SQL begin and listener work. Four O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW0600 records under an owner0700 non-repository root are fsynced with their directory; existing or uncertain records cannot be overwritten, reclaimed or used to rebuild a send handle.
Record inode/device/owner identity and contents remain bound across later checkpoints. A byte-identical inode replacement or journal/root mutation during SQL awaits prevents send.

Closed primitive commitment/observation payloads cannot overwrite reserved envelope fields or persist raw caller/provider data. Private WeakMap handles are one-use and not reconstructible from inspection.

Initiation is durable before authorization link exposure, covering the possibility of browser-created provider sessions. The first locally valid callback is latched synchronously before awaits; duplicate processes and callbacks cannot duplicate initiation or POST.

Actual SQL69 newly_reserved is a prerequisite only. Current source/deadline and exact read-only original admission/configuration checks surround the durable send marker. Actual committed-but-lost acknowledgement and current configuration drift produce zero POSTs.
Only the fresh same-process send handle reaches the fixed transport; every marker fsync/close acknowledgement failure holds. Post-send observation loss retains the consumed attempt without retry.

The actual fixed4110 listener demonstrates Host/Origin/independent CSRF/scoped cookie/query/privacy/rate/deadline guards, static browser continuation, quick clean callback303 while provider work remains pending and read-only result/inspection.

Actual DROP and recreation of the local database leaves the filesystem journal intact; the retained claim prevents even a new SQL connection. Missing database correlation is never permission to resend.
Controller shutdown permanently holds/aborts continuation and closes descriptors without deleting or releasing durable records. Pending SQL completion after shutdown cannot send.

The local database adapter requires the canonical source working directory before allocation, verifies six immutable migration hashes and uses the dedicated preauth role. Relative files from another checkout cannot be installed under an approved source receipt.

Synthetic fake access token data is generated explicitly to retain the existing credential guard. No guard, immutable migration, role prerequisite, provider credential or preserved E2B/68/69 source is weakened.
remaining: Exact-head hosted CI and Desktop/publisher alignment are verified at publication; the current PR checks and outside-repository publication receipt record the result.
Concrete action-time owner approval and observed exact callback registration on the pinned Morrow staging app before any native browser/provider effects.

Controlled staging user/session baseline, approved bounded effects, manual owner Hosted AuthKit challenge and attributable session cleanup/revocation/readback; local token dropping is not provider logout.
Actual keyless provider compatibility, provider wire evidence and cleanup qualification; a synthetic shaped response proves neither a real provider request nor authentication.
WorkOS issuer/JWKS/token verification, trusted provider-ID mapping, audited identity/session lifecycle, hosted infrastructure and merchant production activation remain separate future work.
